verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-four diff remains sound and complete. Non-exact-match reactors are intersected with the repository-owned collaborator roster before the bounded probe set is formed, while the configured maintainer and App identities are emitted only when they actually reacted and remain cap-exempt. Every resulting candidate still passes through the existing exact-match/write+ trust probe; unreadable reaction data yields no approval, and roster failures narrow approval to the exact-match identities. The quarantine decision fails closed for malformed or absent approval flags and preserves the existing author- and actor-trust paths. The tests cover the Python logic, exact workflow argv wiring, paginated and malformed payloads, cap and crowd-out kill controls, roster outages, unauthorized reactions, and execution of the real workflow step. I found no diff-supported correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue.
